verdicts.why: Rhodes and Vision are already allies and nothing turns in Infinity War: Rhodes argues Vision's case with Ross and fights in the same Wakanda battle, but nothing passes directly between them there.
Janet's confession about Kang aboard Krylar's ship adds a secret but does not turn the mother and daughter relationship; they stay family on the same side.

In Thor, Sitwell works under Coulson at the Mjolnir site, warns him of Thor's breach and reports to him through the interrogation and the Destroyer's arrival. That is where their connection starts, before The Consultant.
The press conference line belongs to the later S1#8 stage and is copied onto stage 0, where it gives that event away early.
Maria dies in 1991 and Morgan is born after the Snap. They never meet, and a blood tie never met is not a connection.
Ego brings Mantis to Quill, Gamora and Drax on Berhert while Nebula stays behind as Rocket's prisoner. Nebula first meets Mantis on Ego's planet, when Mantis tells them the bodies are Ego's children.
Coulson does give Hill the scepter intel by video call in S2#19, but they are already allies and nothing turns between them.
The accidental arrow stab and Nebula's radio order to interlock the ships are small moments between teammates. They are not a turn in their alliance.

The Accords split them in Civil War: Natasha sides with Tony and Wanda with Steve. At the airport Wanda pins Natasha's limb and throws her away from Clint. This is a clear turn from the trainer and trainee stage.

Natasha, Steve and Sam save Wanda and Vision from Proxima and Corvus in Edinburgh. In Wakanda Wanda stops the Threshers bearing down on Natasha and Okoye, and they fight Proxima off her. This reunites them after Civil War.

In Vol. 2 Rocket stays on Berhert to watch the prisoner Nebula, Nebula aids Taserface's mutiny that imprisons Rocket, and later they fight on the same side to rescue Quill. The connection starts there, before Endgame.
T'Challa dies of his illness at the start of Wakanda Forever, and at his funeral Okoye, crying, picks up his casket, carries it to the Royal Talon Fighter and salutes. A death is a stage.
They are already enemies, and the hostage exchange in S5#14 continues that rather than turning it. The Superior there is also only an LMD body; his real head is in Hale's possession elsewhere.
Coulson helps the amnesiac Sif again and they settle the dispute over Skye. They stay allies, so nothing clearly turns.

value.title: Loki S2#4
value.text: Sylvie enchants Hunter X-05, who works for Renslayer, and through him prunes Renslayer.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A variant Renslayer arrested as a child, who later prunes her.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The judge who arrested Sylvie as a child, whom Sylvie prunes.

verdicts.why: Renslayer is pruned in S2#4, so the event is real. But it is Hunter X-05, possessed by Sylvie, who prunes her, and the source does not support taking Renslayer's own Time Stick, so the text needs fixing.
Alisa appears in the S1#8 flashbacks of the family car crash with Jessica in the car. That real flashback puts their family tie on screen well before S2#7.
After escaping prison, Alisa drives off with Jessica in the RV, and Jessica stays on the run with her. In S2#13 Trish shoots Alisa dead in front of Jessica. A death is a stage.

In S2#3 Alisa only glances at Trish. Their first real exchange is the S2#10 prison visit, where Alisa says Trish is the reason for every murder and that she should have killed her. That is earlier than the S2#13 stage.
Simpson is tied up on the Brooklyn film set by Trish and killed there by Alisa in AKA Freak Accident, which is S2#2, not S2#7.
Saunders and Fisk never share a scene and Fisk never knows him. Serving on his task force is sharing a crew, and handing Daredevil a key card has no huge consequences for Fisk personally.

In S2#5 Frank only tells Amy that Curtis has a place for them, and Curtis is not with her. They first meet in S2#8, when Curtis makes Frank back off after he throws Amy down and fires shots, then returns that night to eat with her and tell her Frank cares.

In S2#7 Frank asks Curtis in the car to take care of Amy, but she is not there and they have not met yet. Curtis looks after her in the campervan in S2#9, where they track Russo's crew on the radio and talk about her marine salvage dream.
Kim leads the protective detail and fights the AVTF ambush in S2#7, but she is already an ally who joined Daredevil's Army in S1#9. Nothing turns.
In S2#15 Weaver greets Fitz and Simmons, explains how she survived and says she distrusts Coulson's S.H.I.E.L.D. There is no clear falling-out between her and Fitz.
Weaver is only mentioned in S2#16. The control-room scene where she presses May about Deathlok and Theta is in S2#17 (Melinda).
Fitz helping keep the wounded Trip alive in S2#8 happens between friends who stay friends, so nothing turns.
Trip following May's piloting orders to the letter while they evade the Hydra Quinjets happens in S2#10. Both card lines on the S1#18 stage describe that later event.
The S2#10 piloting is cooperation between allies who stay allies, not a turn. Item 102 already fixes the card lines.
In The Defenders#5 Bakuto is only at the Hand leaders' meeting and Matt is not there. They first fight at Midland Circle in #7.

In Iron Fist S1#12 Bakuto turns on Ward. He takes the Meachums hostage, strikes Ward, has the bodyguards killed and tells Ward he will not keep his end of the deal. Davos kills Bakuto in the same title, so it leaves them enemies.
In S2#8 BB is freed by Joy and digs out Davos's bowl on his own, with Danny not involved. He brings it to Danny and Colleen in S2#9.

In S2#8 BB is at odds with Davos, fakes sickness to avoid his raid, and steals his bowl so the Iron Fist can be taken from him. He never returns, so the title leaves them enemies, not mentor and student.

In S1#7 (Art for Art's Sake) Daniel, sitting in Fisk's chair, pressures and implicitly threatens BB into crediting the AVTF. In S1#8 she is still upset and he admits he pushed too hard. A clear falling-out with no stage of its own.
In S2#6 BB decides not to leak the false information and almost kisses Daniel, but he confronts her about her earlier leaks against Fisk. This turn leads into the S2#7 captivity.
In S1#12 Ellison rejects Ben's Fisk story, and when Ben accuses him of being paid off by Fisk, he is fired. A clear falling-out.
In S1#8 (Shadows in the Glass) the masked Matt meets Ben at his car, denies the bombings and gives him Wilson Fisk's name to expose. They meet unmasked only in S1#9.

In S2#1 Beth and Frank sleep together and have breakfast with her son. The next night she is shot in his fight at the bar and he rushes her to hospital. She appears only in S2#1 and S2#2, so 'becomes his friend' is unsupported.
In Iron Fist S2#10 Bethany confirms the baby is Ward's, turns down his promise to be there, kisses him and says goodbye. The romance ends with no stage.
